PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Skip safety briefings for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Hazardous Substances.
